title: Newhalo form field
description: An outlined 40px form field with 4px corners and its small label set into a gap in the top border. Text, email, phone, a multi-line message box or a select with a thin chevron. The 30% hairline darkens on hover and turns orange on focus.
notes: works on light and dark panels (uses input / foreground / ring tokens)
name: newhalo-field

props.name: label
props.description: the small label that sits in a gap of the top border

props.name: kind
props.description: text-like input types, a multi-line textarea, or a select

props.name: placeholder
props.description: grey hint inside the empty field (for select: the first, empty choice)

props.name: required
props.description: marks it required and puts an asterisk before the label
